data.gender_notes: Bhadur is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhadur is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bhaudhru’ meaning brave, strong, and valiant. In Hindu mythology, Bhadur is a title given to various gods and goddesses signifying their courage and strength. The name Bhadur carries the meaning “Brave, Strong, Valiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhadur usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and bravery, inspiring fearlessness and determination.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhadur total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
